findings.title: Minimal Sufficient State and Distributional Closure
findings.claim: The 4-dimensional vector (M, F, E, C) constitutes the minimal sufficient macrostate for Pineland, achieving 100% pass rate (14/14 targets) with max regret 0.068 <= 0.10 against 70+ expanded microstate variables across 30d and 90d horizons.

evidence.cross_validation: Seed-grouped CV across 16 seeds and 34 localities

findings.title: Rooted Membership Spatial Reproduction and Generation Time Density
findings.claim: Spatial branching strictly requires rooted civilian membership M; parent types lacking M produce exactly zero spatial offspring. The empirical generation time density g(t) has mean 59.44d, median 56.0d, and plateaus at 158d, yielding an asymptotic reproduction number rho(K_infinity) = 6.394 (95% CI [6.036, 6.665]).

findings.title: Mobilization Burn and Organizational Resource Exhaustion
findings.claim: 100% of trajectory collapses (607/607 across 960 runs) coincide with complete organizational capital exhaustion (K=0). The naive scalar strain law sigma = rf/c is falsified (dispersion 62.5% > 15%); operational burn is driven by a 3-term law Burn = kappa_r*r + kappa_rf*r*f + kappa_f*f reflecting upfront supply reservations and maintenance.

findings.title: State Institutional Regeneration Inertia and Hysteresis
findings.claim: Local government institutional capacity exhibits deep hysteresis and does not passively regenerate from central fiscal subsidy over 180 days (mean final gap closure Q_capacity(180) = 0.0068, fraction reaching Q_50 = 0.0%, monotone rescue fraction = 0.0%).

findings.title: Competitive Net Margin Gamma Governs Bifurcation and Survival
findings.claim: Log institutional capacity ratio Gamma(t) = log(G_I) - log(G_S) governs control bifurcation and predicts insurgent survival with AUC = 0.766, superior to raw kinetic force ratio (AUC = 0.746) and raw violence level (AUC = 0.583, R2 = -0.001).

findings.title: Six Universal Regimes in Dimensionless Phase Space
findings.claim: The phase space of insurgent-state competition is partitioned into 6 qualitative regimes across dimensionless coordinates (Pi_0, Pi_M, Pi_S, Gamma): Endogenous Extinction, Mobilization Trap, Externally Maintained Persistence, Localized Endemic, Spatial Expansion, and State Consolidation.

findings.title: High-Fidelity Trajectory Reconstruction via 15-Parameter Dynamical System
findings.claim: A 15-parameter (<= 15) continuous spatial dynamical system compresses Pineland multi-agent behavior with 95.0% composite qualitative regime accuracy (90.0% mobilization sweep accuracy, 100.0% macrostate persistence accuracy), passing the 90% fidelity threshold.

global_guard: SYNTHETIC MECHANISM RESULT. All findings characterize native Pineland agent-based simulation dynamics and candidate theoretical compressions under zero historical tuning.
